implement.approach: Regression first (commit 326c4ae2, black-box through routesHarness against the REAL handler; fixture built in-file so it runs unchanged on BASE). Fix in releasePolicy.ts: ReleasePolicyError now distinguishes `storage` (RPC/transport failure, retryable) from `integrity` (readable but untrusted); new `admitChargeableRelease()` evaluates the shared resolveAnalysisReleaseEligibility for a real, intent-confirmed observation inside the policy's own supported domain (so only lineage/approval/withdrawal/validity can reject) and `readChargeableReleaseAdmission()` returns active | ineligible{reasonCode} | unavailable{error}. index.ts: `chargeableReleaseAdmission()` reads UNCACHED via the service-role client (RPC is EXECUTE-granted to service_role only; withdrawal honoured on the next request). reserveAnalysisPermit(): ineligible → 409 {error:{code:'access.release_not_authorized'}, release:{status:'ineligible',reasonCode}} before reserve_analysis_permit; unavailable → existing serviceUnavailable 503. syncShots(): one authority read per batch only when a non-replayed `scored` shot is present; ineligible → typed per-shot rejection (same code, SYNC_STATUS_MESSAGES copy) and apply_synced_shot is never called for it; unavailable → 503 for the batch (outbox keeps every row — same convention as the replay lookup directly above); low_confidence/partial settle regardless; replays acknowledged without a read. Parser accepts resultKind=partial (already accepted by migration 20260908020000's apply_synced_shot) with overallScore=null enforced. No new console sink (http_test pins index.ts at 18). Harnesses model read_analysis_release_policy with an ACTIVE fixture so the 11 pre-existing permit/scored-sync scenarios keep describing a released production.

supabase/functions/api/__wf__/xc_concurrency_harness.ts — additive: FakeSupabase models rpc/read_analysis_release_policy (service role → fixture, user → 403 42501 mirroring the grant); previously answered PGRST202 'not modelled' which made every permit/scored-sync xc scenario a 503
residual_risks: Out-of-scope harness edits (routesHarness.ts, xc_concurrency_harness.ts, new releasePolicyFixture.ts) were required for the full Edge suite to pass: with the gate in place the pre-existing permit/scored-sync scenarios otherwise hit PGRST202/404 for read_analysis_release_policy and 503'd (12 failures observed before the harness fix). The edits are additive defaults/models; no existing assertion, count or ordering was changed. Reviewer decides scope justification.

Behavioural choice: an UNREADABLE authority during shots:sync is a 503 for the whole batch (retryable, outbox keeps every row — same as the existing replay-lookup failure), not a per-shot verdict; adding a per-shot log would have added a console sink that http_test.ts pins (index.ts == 18). Ineligible (non-storage) authority is still the typed, non-5xx per-shot rejection the objective requires.

Production data-state consequence (INFERRED from migration 20260908020000): the database default has no installed policy and deny_new_authorizations=true, so once deployed, permit reservation and scored settlement return the typed 409 / per-shot rejection until an operator installs+approves an active policy. This is the intended P0 behaviour but it is a release-sequencing dependency for W01/W04.

Client handling of the new 409 `access.release_not_authorized` (permit) and the new sync rejection code is not part of this package; the mobile app's ApiError reads error.code, and the sync code lands in `rejected` like other terminal verdicts. Existing SYNC_STATUS_MESSAGES copy conventions were followed (no accuracy/superlative claims).

The parser now accepts resultKind=partial with overallScore=null (matching the applied migration); a `partial` carrying a score is refused as shot.invalid_payload. UNKNOWN whether any in-field build ever sends `partial`; behaviour is additive.

DEFECT ON BASE_SHA (VERIFIED by the failing regression run): supabase/functions/api/index.ts reserveAnalysisPermit (BASE lines 1497–1561) calls `authed.db.rpc("reserve_analysis_permit")` (line 1521) with no read of the release authority, so a permit — the admission of a chargeable scored run — is reserved with no installed/approved policy (production default: `document=null, approval=null, denyNewAuthorizations=true`), or with a withdrawn, expired or digest-mismatched one. syncShots (BASE lines 1990+) loops straight into `authed.db.rpc("apply_synced_shot")` for every non-replayed shot, so `resultKind=scored` settles finalized/scored (the charge / spent free rating) without any authority check; parseSyncShot (BASE lines 1785–1786) still rejects `resultKind=partial` with `shot.invalid_payload`, so the non-chargeable partial path that migration 20260908100000 added at the SQL layer (and its header defers to serial group edge-index) is unreachable from the app. releasePolicy.ts on BASE only offers readVerifiedReleasePolicy (used by GET /v1/analysis/release-policy) and collapses transport failure and integrity failure into one untyped ReleasePolicyError.

FIX (write_paths only for shipping code): releasePolicy.ts — ReleasePolicyError gains `failure: "storage" | "integrity"` (+ cause); new `ChargeableReleaseAdmission` = active | ineligible{reasonCode} | unavailable{error}; `admitChargeableRelease(policy, now)` evaluates the SHARED eligibility rules (resolveAnalysisReleaseEligibility via eligibilityForVerifiedRelease) for a real, intent-confirmed observation inside the policy's own supported domain so only lineage/approval/withdrawal/deny-switch/validity can reject; `readChargeableReleaseAdmission(read, now)` = uncached read + admission, mapping integrity failure → ineligible/unverified and storage failure → unavailable. index.ts — `chargeableReleaseAdmission()` reads through the service-role client (`read_analysis_release_policy()` is EXECUTE-granted to service_role only; missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ⇒ unavailable, never authorization); reserveAnalysisPermit gates BEFORE the reserve RPC: ineligible ⇒ typed 409 `{error:{code:"access.release_not_authorized",message}, release:{status:"ineligible",reasonCode}}` (non-5xx, nothing reserved, nothing counted), unavailable ⇒ generic 503 (retryable, nothing reserved); syncShots takes ONE uncached authority read per batch only when a non-replayed scored shot is present — unavailable ⇒ 503 for the batch (outbox keeps every row, apply never called), ineligible ⇒ per-shot typed rejection `access.release_not_authorized` for scored shots while low_confidence/partial shots in the same batch settle normally; parseSyncShot admits `resultKind=partial` with `overallScore=null` (a partial carrying a score is still invalid), matching the SQL vocabulary.
